what: Candidate BM-unit-to-TEC-register links proposed by an external classifier, each admitted or rejected by hand against the register vintage below. Grade R in wind_units.csv.
admission_rule: 1. A model never writes a side. It proposes a candidate link with a probability; the link enters the record only as a claim carrying the model's name and version as provenance.
2. A probability threshold selects the review queue. Above it a named human reads the register row and the BM unit record and records accept or reject with a reason. Below it nothing happens.

3. Acceptance needs the same evidence the rule needs: the register row's plant type must name wind, its HOST TO (or, for OFTO, evidence/ofto-rows.json) must imply a side, and its capacity must sit within 15 % of the unit's own capacity or of the declared BM-unit group's total. A name agreement the capacity does not support is not enough, whatever the probability.
4. Admitted links carry grade R, never A, B or C. Dropping every grade R row recovers a classification no model and no reviewer touched.
5. Nothing here is ever auto-adopted into a sealed result, and no sealed declaration is re-run under a rule it did not use.

threshold.note: Stated plainly: this threshold was chosen after the classifier's run was read, so it is a review-queue cut and not a pre-declaration. It selected 17 of 194 units. For any future pass the threshold is declared before the model is run, in the investigation's declaration or amendment, and the queue it selects is reviewed whole -- including the entries a reviewer would rather not have seen.

proposer.interface: Noul, one yes/no question per candidate pair
proposer.note: The model is a proposer. It produced no explanation, no citation and no arithmetic, and none of its output is relied on for any figure here.

queue.note: 5 + 5 + 5 + 2 = 17. T_FARR-2 is the sibling: it was proposed at 0.77, below the queue cut, but shares the register row of T_FARR-1 and passes the per-unit capacity limb on its own, so it is admitted with it rather than leaving one half of a station placed and the other not.

links.note: Placed south from evidence/ofto-rows.json (Heysham landfall), not from the OFTO label.

Capacity does not reconcile on either limb: the BM unit is registered at 426.916 MW against a 235 MW register row (45 % apart, tolerance 15 %). The register's only other South Kyle row ('South Kyle 2 Wind farm', 92.4 MW, Scoping) does not close the gap either (327.4 MW aggregate, 23 % apart). The name agrees exactly and the model scored 0.91, but name agreement alone does not place a unit. Not determinable from the declared evidence.

The station's two BM units are registered at 287.699 and 230.159 MW, summing to 517.9 MW against a 300 MW register row -- 173 % of it. Neither limb of the capacity test is therefore informative here: T_THNTO-1's 4.3 % per-unit agreement with 300 MW is an arithmetic coincidence, not evidence, and the group limb is 73 % out. Rejected, and T_THNTO-2 with it. Left unknown.
